call_points.text: Full commissioning of spinning and weaving expansions expected by end of December 2026.
Trial production of griege woven fabric commenced, producing 4.1 Mn Mtrs in Q2.
About 60% of the new 22,400 MTPA spinning capacity will feed captive fabric manufacturing.
Fabric is targeted to rise to ~30% of total revenue by FY28.
Management expects to add 30-35% to existing revenue figures from capacity additions and price normalisation.
The capex will expand fabric capacity by 35 mn metres and spinning capacity by 22,000 tons in H2FY27.
Peak total debt post-capex and working capital is expected at ₹1,900 Cr to ₹2,000 Cr.
Renewable energy expansion expected to yield ₹50 Cr annual savings once fully operational, and ₹30-35 Cr in FY27.
Average yarn spreads widened to ₹120-125/kg from ₹110/kg in Q4FY26, supported by destocking recovery and restocking.
Blended average cost of borrowing stands at 5.6% overall and under 7% for working capital.
Spinning capacity utilization stood over 98% and woven fabric utilization over 90% in Q4FY26.

operating_notes.text: Operating cash flow reached ₹410.52 Cr in FY26 against net profit of ₹177.55 Cr, while capex stood at ₹60.42 Cr.
Average yarn spreads increased to ₹120-125/kg in May 2026 compared to ₹110/kg in Q4FY26.
Renewable energy investments expected to yield power cost savings of ₹30-35 Cr in FY27 and ₹50 Cr annually once complete.
Blended cost of borrowing stands at ~5.6%, with working capital facilities under 7%.
H1FY27 raw material costs stood at 62.2% of revenue compared to 65.5% in H1FY26.
Capital work-in-progress reached ₹915.16 Cr as of September 30, 2026, for ongoing capacity expansion.
H1FY27 operating cash flow of ₹209.26 Cr was impacted by a ₹171.83 Cr increase in trade receivables.
Trial production of griege woven fabric commenced, yielding 4.1 Mn Mtrs in Q2FY27.
Renewable energy pipeline of 95.4 MW planned to cover 50-55% of annual power needs, saving ~₹50 Cr annually.
